expected.name: Devin Montgomery
expected.description: Devin Montgomery, 24, was charged in Pittsburgh, PA with malicious damage to property of an organization receiving federal financial assistance after he and another individual were seen on video lighting things on fire and tossing them into the back of a Pittsburgh Bureau of Police vehicle. The grand jury also charged Montgomery and Brandon Benson with bank burglary at the Dollar Bank, 537 Smithfield Street. Sentenced to 48 months federal prison and 3 years supervised release plus restitution.

operations.name: Peter Sprunger-Froese

expected.name: Peter Sprunger-Froese
expected.description: Peter Sprunger-Froese cut the outer fence and entered the Rocky Flats nuclear weapons plant grounds to pray on December 25, 1981. Arrested and taken to jail, the five protesters refused bond at their December 28 arraignment. A January 17, 1982 contemporary report confirms that they remained jailed after a January 8 hearing, facing contempt proceedings for violating an injunction against trespass at the plant.
expected.body: Source: National No-Nukes Prison Support Collective newsletter, January 17, 1982, page 1. Custody is historical; an exact release date has not been verified.

operations.source: NWTRCC interview by Ruth Benn, March9,2015, published December1,2015. Caption identifies Peter and Mary with Scout. https://nwtrcc.org/2015/12/01/strength-in-community-peter-and-mary-sprunger-froese/
